newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it left its draining and emergency lending rates unchanged on the eve of a new commercial bank accounting period.
The draining rate, used to drain funds from the money market, remains at 6.2 percent and the emergency lending rate at 8.3 percent.
The central bank said it offered to inject 10 billion escudos of seven-day funds into the money market in a variable rate repurchase pact. Bids must be submitted by 1515 GMT.
